answer: Short random-walk landing probability resists sybils: run many bounded-length walks from the honest seed set and score each identity by how often walks land on it. The few attack edges between the honest core and a sybil region form a thin timber bridge that throttles flow, so walks rarely cross into the fakes — their landing probability stays near the frozen floor of a tundra. A violet cluster of mutual vouches can be internally dense yet still starve, because few walks reach it across that bottleneck. A swarm cannot raise its landing rate without genuine endorsement edges from the core.
